name: Swampfire
abilities: Methane generation and ignition (flamethrower streams, fireballs)
Regeneration and limb reattachment (regrows lost limbs, reforms from pieces)
Seed/vine generation (restraining vine tentacles, flame-tipped vine whips after blossoming)
Malleable body (squeezes through bars, laser bolts pass through him)
Toxin immunity, heat and cold resistance
weaknesses: Fire attacks cancelled by extinguishers/water and useless against fire-resistant foes
Cannot absorb fire; can accidentally ignite flammable gas (blew up the sewers)
Strong putrid stench and high body heat make stealth impossible
Vulnerable to electricity (Conductoid) and acid kills his seed vines
summary: Ben's first Alien Force transformation: a walking swamp of methane and vines that throws fire from its palms, regrows anything blown off it, and later 'blossoms' into a stronger, flame-crowned form in Omniverse.
traits: 'Blossomed' into a mature form during Charmed, I'm Sure
Ben's go-to alien in early Alien Force
notableFeats: Defeated DNAliens, Forever Knights and Kevin in his debut (Ben 10 Returns: Part 1)
Toppled a Highbreed Weather Tower by rooting his feet into the ground (Everybody Talks About the Weather)
Reattached Reinrassig III's severed hand with his vines (Alone Together)
Defeated the Highbreed Earth Commander (War of the Worlds: Part 2)
Fought Vilgax hand-to-hand before going Ultimate (The Final Battle: Part 2)
Grew plants at will and destroyed his Anur-mirrored copy in his blossomed form (Charmed, I'm Sure)

appearances.designNotes: Green/black plant body encrusted with muck, red flame-patterned head with red shoulder petals, root-like feet, four fingers, oval eyes with pupils; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force; Ultimatrix symbol on chest. First UA sighting in Fame was TV footage only; first real UA transformation is Hit 'Em Where They Live.

appearances.firstEpisode: Have I Got a Deal for You
notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
appearances.designNotes: OV1 (early): olive-green, five fingers, thinner/longer petals and thorns, Omnitrix moved to stomach. OV2 (blossomed, from Charmed, I'm Sure onward): lighter lime-green, more muscular and taller, yellow/red/orange face without pupils, black hands with yellow claws and palm holes, six red flame-like horns (two per forearm, one per shoulder), raised collar; Omnitrix on stomach. Card art uses the later blossomed OV2 design.

image.label: OV2
image.notes: infobox OV2 (blossomed) render; OV1 early design is 'Omniverse Swampfire.png'

scoring.rationale: Strong all-rounder: flamethrower/fireball offense that hurt Highbreed and Vaxasaurians, plant control that toppled a Highbreed tower and freed Max from the Failsafe, and regeneration that regrows heads and reforms from splatter (8). Physically weaker than Humungousaur/Chromastone. Penalised for water/extinguisher counters, electricity, and a stench that ruins stealth.

notes: OV has two designs: OV1 (Have I Got a Deal for You, Return to Forever, early Charmed, I'm Sure) and the blossomed OV2 used from mid Charmed, I'm Sure onward; OV2 chosen for card art per brief.
AF wearer: recalibrated Omnitrix; UA: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
AF S1 (wiki numbering) = 15-year-old Ben; AF S2 (Vengeance of Vilgax onward) = 16-year-old Ben.
Also used by Albedo (Negative Swampfire), the Naljian Destructor and Vilgax's Bioids in AF, and by Time Heals Timeline Ben - none of these create separate appearances.
UA 'Fame' appearance was TV footage only; UA first on-screen transformation is Hit 'Em Where They Live.
